product.title: Red Rock Canyon with Rocky Gap 4x4 Adventure
product.description: Explore Red Rock Canyon and continue into the Rocky Gap corridor on a purpose-built 4x4 route from Las Vegas. This outing combines classic Red Rock scenery with a more technical Rocky Gap segment for travelers seeking a canyon + 4x4 identity rather than a standard scenic transfer.
highlights: 4x4 route through Red Rock Canyon and Rocky Gap
Interpretation on geology and desert ecosystems
Scenic photo stops with layered red sandstone views
Round-trip logistics from Las Vegas area
additionalInfo: Terrain can be bumpy on the Rocky Gap segment.
Pickup timing depends on your selected departure.

start.description: Pickup available at select Las Vegas Strip hotels with exact pickup points and times confirmed after booking.

itineraryItems.title: Las Vegas departure
itineraryItems.description: Depart the city and travel toward Red Rock Canyon.

itineraryItems.title: Red Rock Canyon scenic route
itineraryItems.description: Travel through key overlooks and geological formations in the conservation area.

itineraryItems.title: Rocky Gap 4x4 segment
itineraryItems.description: Continue on rougher 4x4 trails for the dedicated Rocky Gap adventure section.

faqs.question: Does this include both Red Rock Canyon and Rocky Gap?
faqs.answer: Yes, the itinerary includes Red Rock Canyon sightseeing and a separate Rocky Gap 4x4 segment.
